kw:exhaust.name: Exhaust
kw:exhaust.text: Removed until the end of combat.

kw:vulnerable.name: Vulnerable
kw:vulnerable.text: Receive 50% more damage from Attacks for X turns.

kw:innate.name: Innate
kw:innate.text: Start each combat with this card in your hand.

kw:plating.name: Plating
kw:plating.text: At the end of your turn, gain X Block. Plating is reduced by 1 at the start of your turn.

kw:weak.name: Weak
kw:weak.text: Attacks deal 25% less damage for X turns.

kw:fatal.name: Fatal
kw:fatal.text: Triggers when this card kills a non-minion enemy.

kw:upgrade.name: Upgrade
kw:upgrade.text: Upgrading cards makes them more powerful. Cards can only be upgraded once.

kw:dexterity.name: Dexterity
kw:dexterity.text: Increases Block gained from cards by X.

kw:poison.name: Poison
kw:poison.text: At the start of its turn, loses X HP, then reduce Poison by 1.

kw:sly.name: Sly
kw:sly.text: If this card is discarded from your Hand before the end of the turn, play it for free.

kw:retain.name: Retain
kw:retain.text: Retained cards are not discarded at the end of turn.

kw:thorns.name: Thorns
kw:thorns.text: When hit by an attack, deal X damage back.

kw:intangible.name: Intangible
kw:intangible.text: Reduce all damage taken and HP loss to 1. Lasts for X turns.

card:minion-strike.name: Minion Strike
card:minion-strike.text: Deal 6(9) damage. Draw 1 card. Exhaust.

kw:vigor.name: Vigor
kw:vigor.text: Your next Attack deals X additional damage.

kw:forge.name: Forge
kw:forge.text: The first time you Forge each combat, add Sovereign Blade into your Hand. Adds additional damage to Sovereign Blade.

kw:replay.name: Replay
kw:replay.text: Plays this card an additional time.

kw:ethereal.name: Ethereal
kw:ethereal.text: If an Ethereal card is in your hand at the end of your turn, it is Exhausted.

kw:summon.name: Summon
kw:summon.text: Summon Osty with X HP. If already summoned, raise his Max HP by X for this combat.

kw:doom.name: Doom
kw:doom.text: At the end of the enemy turn, if it has X or less HP, it dies.

kw:osty.name: Osty
kw:osty.text: Osty can only attack if he's alive. Osty's attack damage is not affected by Strength or Weak.

card:sweeping-gaze.name: Sweeping Gaze
card:sweeping-gaze.text: Ethereal. Osty deals 10(15) damage to a random enemy. Exhaust.

kw:eternal.name: Eternal
kw:eternal.text: Cannot be removed or transformed from your Deck.

kw:channel.name: Channel
kw:channel.text: Channeling an Orbs puts it into your first empty slot. If you have no empty slots, your first Orb is automatically Evoked to make room.

kw:lightning.name: Lightning
kw:lightning.text: A type of Orbs. Passive: Deal 3 (+ Focus) damage to a random enemy. Evoke: Deals 8 (+ Focus) damage to a random enemy.

kw:frost.name: Frost
kw:frost.text: A type of Orbs. Passive: Gains 2 (+ Focus) Block. Evoke: Gains 5 (+ Focus) Block.

kw:focus.name: Focus
kw:focus.text: Increases the effectiveness of Orbs by X.

card:void.name: Void
card:void.text: Unplayable. Ethereal. Whenever you draw this card, lose ⚡.

kw:transform.name: Transform
kw:transform.text: Transformed cards become a random card of any rarity, unless specified.

card:fuel.name: Fuel
card:fuel.text: Gain ⚡(⚡⚡). Exhaust.

kw:dark.name: Dark
kw:dark.text: A type of Orbs. Passive: Increases damage by 6 (+ Focus) every turn. Evoke: Deals stored damage to the enemy with the least HP.

kw:plasma.name: Plasma
kw:plasma.text: A type of Orbs. Passive: Gain 1 ⚡ Energy. Evoke: Gain 2 ⚡ Energy.

kw:glass.name: Glass
kw:glass.text: A type of Orbs. Passive: Deals 4 (+ Focus) damage to ALL enemies. Decreases damage every turn. Evoke: Deal damage equal to double its Passive damage to ALL enemies.

card:burn.name: Burn
card:burn.text: Unplayable. At the end of your turn, if this is in your Hand, take 2 damage.

kw:evoke.name: Evoke
kw:evoke.text: Consume your rightmost Orb and use its Evoke effect.

kw:stunned.name: Stunned
kw:stunned.text: This enemy can't act on its next turn.

kw:unplayable.name: Unplayable
kw:unplayable.text: Cannot be played from your Hand.

kw:frail.name: Frail
kw:frail.text: Gain 25% less Block from cards for X turns.

kw:energy.name: Energy
kw:energy.text: Energy is used to play cards from your Hand.

kw:confused.name: Confused
kw:confused.text: The costs of your cards are randomized on draw, from 0 to 3.

kw:enchant.name: Enchant
kw:enchant.text: Add an Enchantment to a card in your Deck.

card:dowsing.name: Dowsing
card:dowsing.text: Unplayable. After entering 5 more ? rooms, transforms into Abundance.

potion:ambergris.name: Ambergris
potion:ambergris.text: Heal for 50% of your max HP. If used in combat, take an extra turn.

card:luminesce.name: Luminesce
card:luminesce.text: Retain. Gain ⚡⚡(⚡⚡⚡). Exhaust.

kw:regen.name: Regen
kw:regen.text: At the end of your turn, heal X HP, then reduce Regen by 1.

kw:buffer.name: Buffer
kw:buffer.text: Prevent the next X times you would lose HP.

kw:ritual.name: Ritual
kw:ritual.text: At the end of its turn, gains X Strength.

kw:shrink.name: Shrink
kw:shrink.text: Attacks deal 30% less damage.Removed when the applier diesafter 3 turns.

kw:constrict.name: Constrict
kw:constrict.text: While the Slithering Strangler is alive, at the end of your turn, take X damage.

kw:tangled.name: Tangled
kw:tangled.text: Attacks cost an additional ⚡ for 2 turns.

card:infection.name: Infection
card:infection.text: Unplayable. At the end of your turn, if this is in your Hand, take 3 damage.

kw:smoggy.name: Smoggy
kw:smoggy.text: You can only play 1 Skill per turn.

kw:tender.name: Tender
kw:tender.text: Whenever you play a card, lose X Strength and X Dexterity this turn.

card:toxic.name: Toxic
card:toxic.text: At the end of your turn, if this is in your Hand, take 5 damage. Exhaust.

kw:flutter.name: Flutter
kw:flutter.text: Receives 50% less damage from Attacks. Deal attack damage X times to Stun it.

kw:burrowed.name: Burrowed
kw:burrowed.text: Block is not removed at the start of its turn. Stunned if all Block is removed.

kw:soar.name: Soar
kw:soar.text: Receives 50% less attack damage until it lands.

kw:personal-hive.name: Personal Hive
kw:personal-hive.text: Whenever this enemy is hit by an Attack, add X Dazed into your Draw Pile.

kw:hex.name: Hex
kw:hex.text: While Spectral Knight is alive, ALL your cards are Ethereal.

kw:dampen.name: Dampen
kw:dampen.text: While Magi Knight is alive, ALL your cards are Downgraded.

kw:plow.name: Plow
kw:plow.text: The first time this enemy's HP reaches X or below, it becomes Stunned and loses all its Strength.

kw:ringing.name: Ringing
kw:ringing.text: You can only play 1 card this turn.

card:beckon.name: Beckon
card:beckon.text:
At the end of your turn, if this is in your Hand,
 lose 6 HP.

kw:steam-eruption.name: Steam Eruption
kw:steam-eruption.text: When killed, deals X damage at the end of your next turn.

kw:sandpit.name: Sandpit
kw:sandpit.text: In X turns, you will be eaten and die.

card:frantic-escape.name: Frantic Escape
card:frantic-escape.text: Get farther away. Increase Sandpit by 1. Increase the cost of this card by 1.

kw:hunger.name: Hunger
kw:hunger.text: Whenever you play an Attack or Skill, it is Exhausted.

kw:scrutiny.name: Scrutiny
kw:scrutiny.text: You cannot draw additional cards during your turn.

kw:grasp.name: Grasp
kw:grasp.text: Whenever you play a card, lose ⚡.

kw:chains-of-binding.name: Chains of Binding
kw:chains-of-binding.text: The first X cards drawn each turn are Afflicted with Bound.

card:wither.name: Wither
card:wither.text: Unplayable. At the end of your turn, if this is in your Hand, take 3(6) damage.

kw:withering-presence.name: Withering Presence
kw:withering-presence.text: Every 6 cards you play, add a Wither to your Hand.

kw:minion.name: Minion
kw:minion.text: Minions abandon combat without their leader.
